replies.question: What rate would someone with a 15% deposit get?
replies.reply:
A 15% deposit means an LVR of 85%, which falls in the 80.01% to 90% band. The page on examplelender.com.au (read 13 Oct 2026, 12:00 pm Perth time) shows this as 6.44% p.a. variable, with the comparison rate shown as (blank) — not stated — and the monthly fee also shown as (blank), so neither of those is given for that band.

Note: rates on that page are subject to change without notice, so if this is more than a day old it's worth checking the page again for the current figure.

replies.question: What is the comparison rate for someone borrowing 85% of the value?
replies.reply:
At 85% LVR (the 80.01% to 90% band) on the Example Basic Home Loan, the page shows the interest rate as 6.44% p.a., but the comparison rate cell is blank — no value is shown for that band. The monthly fee cell is also blank for that row.

This is from the examplelender.com.au page read 13 Oct 2026, 12:00 pm Perth time.
